title.en: A request whose recipeHash differs from the hub's copy is refused

goal.en: Every request names the exact recipe revision by its hash. Hash the recipe the hub holds, send a request with a different hash and see the refusal, then send the right hash.

note.en: Fetch the shakshuka recipe the hub holds.
Hash it: sha256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON, excluding the hash and signature fields. This is the value a request must carry.
Send a request with a hash of all zeros. The hub refuses with recipe_hash_mismatch and tells you which hash it holds.
The same request with the right hash is accepted.

cli: jq '. + {"x-hub-human-present": true}' examples/core/execute-request.json | curl -s -X POST http://localhost:7878/v1/executions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: ex-2026-10-04-001-a' -d @-

outcome.en: You can compute the hash a request needs and have seen that a stale or edited recipe is refused. Next: scenario 055 compares a hash with the field inside a recipe file.
